notes: baselineStatus, baselineInventoryEvidence and expectedGap are measurements,
not predictions: they were written from the baseline run recorded under
baselineRun. The evaluator recomputes all three on every run and reports any
case whose declaration no longer matches, so a stale fixture cannot pass a
RESOLVED means the expected publication becomes an actionable candidate and
so reaches a human. A publication that is retrieved but rejected by the
actionable gate is a GAP, because for scientific-return purposes it was
baselineInventoryEvidence records whether that candidate carries primary
inventory evidence. RESOLVED with false is an ENRICH_CANDIDATE target; GAP
expectedGap is the cause, and UNKNOWN means the article itself has not been
inspected. citedInventoryForms are the literal strings printed in the
article and are the evidence behind the declared cause.
